title: onboard-aurora-zen-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Aurora-Zen 13B v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, curated performance profiles, and changelog automation. Motivation: Aurora-Zen is a widely requested 13B open model with favorable latency/cost characteristics for our mid-tier offering. This PR adds a model manifest, per-hardware perf profiles (A100, RTX6000, T4), basic quantization/recommendation hints, and an automated changelog generator that produces a release note entry from the model metadata. Also adds schema validation tests and updates onboarding docs. Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest and metadata (owner, tags, license, validation prompts) - [x] Generate perf profiles from benchmark-lab runs and attach summaries - [x] Add changelog automation workflow and script - [x] Add manifest/schema validation tests - [x] Update onboarding docs and README - [x] CI green (re-ran flaky perf CI) Notes: Perf numbers were produced from internal benchmark-lab runs (2025-02-06..2025-02-08) and include median latency (p50/p95) and cost-estimated token throughput for typical chat workloads. The changelog automation is conservative: it creates a draft CHANGELOG entry in .changelog/drafts and requires maintainer review before publishing to CHANGELOG.md. Related: ENG-7821 (onboarding process improvements), PM-412 (model catalog request).
